property_summary: For any admissible (identifier, time, ancillaryData), a requestPrice call from the optimistic asserter must actually record a price request (emitting PriceRequestAdded), which is observable as the call costing several thousand gas more than a same-calldata no-op call to a plain receiver; the mutant's empty body is a cheap no-op, so its overhead never reaches that bound for some (indeed any) input.
change_summary: Remove the event emission so a requestPrice call no longer records the price request via PriceRequestAdded.
